commands.command: git fetch origin && git checkout origin/phase-3/gui-operations -- scripts/clipboard_capture.py

commands.description: Quick test: manually capture current clipboard to notes
commands.command:
python -c "import pyperclip; from pathlib import Path; from datetime import datetime; d=Path.home()/'Documents'/'Notes'; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); c=pyperclip.paste(); f=open(d/'captures.md','a',encoding='utf-8'); f.write(f'
---
**Test capture: {datetime.now()}**

{c[:100]}
'); f.close(); print('OK - captured to Notes/captures.md')"
